summary: Whirlpool Corporation filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $2.0 billion aggregate principal of 7.500% Senior Secured Second Lien Notes due 2031 and 7.875% Notes due 2034 in a private placement under Rule 144A/Regulation S. Proceeds will fund a concurrent tender offer for its 1.250% Notes due 2026 and 1.100% Notes due 2027, repay its unsecured revolver, and pay fees. This is a routine debt refinancing transaction, not a special situation. The filing discloses no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special-situations event.
